name: Kamaitachi no Yoru 2 ~Kangokujima no Warabe Uta~
original_name: かまいたちの夜2 ～監獄島のわらべ唄～
source: Abiko Takemaru, the creator of "Kamaitachi no Yoru" decides to invite all of the people he has based his characters on to his mansion on the otherwise deserted island of Mikazuki. When they arrive they find themselves stuck on the island with their host inexplicably missing and an unknown culprit hunting down people according to an old song.
translation: 《恐怖惊魂夜》的创作者我孙子武丸决定邀请所有角色原型人物，前往他位于三日月岛荒僻之地的宅邸。众人抵达后，却发现自己被困在岛上，主人也莫名失踪；与此同时，一名身份不明的凶手正依照一首古老童谣逐个猎杀他们。
